text:
sam: Heads up - vuln triage next week will need short-lived read access to raw auth logs. CMK rotation for SIEM exports is on the same day. We need a safe flow for JIT access + ensure exported files are scrubbed for PII before any handing out.

julia: agree. Proposal: issue ephemeral decrypt tokens scoped to `logs/auth/*` for 2 hrs, require request with ticket id and approver. Add masking pipeline stage for any ad-hoc export.

mohit: can we enforce at proxy level so partner tokens can't request ephemeral access? Proxy should validate role and `reason` field.

oncall: operational note: we already have a lambda that mints short-lived S3 presigned URLs and a KMS-proxy that can mint decrypt grants. Need glue to tie both and add audit event. I'll add to rotation checklist: ensure no active ephemeral grants older than 15m.

sec-bot: REMINDER: create audit alert for any ad-hoc export without `ticket_id` or `approver`.

sam: owners: julia owns the request form + approval flow, mohit owns proxy changes, oncall will update runbook. Schedule a smoke test in staging.

julia: I'll draft the minimal form: {ticket_id, approver, reason, retention_days, masking_profile}. Will post PR by EOD.

mohit: will add proxy validation and reject external consumer tokens. ETA 48h.

oncall: staging smoke test set for 09:30 UTC tomorrow. I'll monitor.

sam: thanks all.
